method: A separately identified final source-first pass by the same AI operator challenged the implemented no-match as well as the earlier positive construction. Re-read VU article 10.3 and the religion-specific social-science, hermeneutics and philosophy/theology course objectives, then checked the current exception and audience text against them and actual enriched UCR course evidence. The pass did not infer correctness from either prior approval or the correction rationale. No separate human reviewer or external panel is claimed.
factsRechecked: Current adopted general VU route remains complete at 180 EC, not an unresolved external curriculum. General religious/worldview traditions, claims, comparison/dialogue and disciplinary perspectives are explicit learning outcomes.
The UCR catalogue provides genuine religious-cultural examples and general analytical methods; the specific positive connections acknowledged in the 24-course challenge are supported.
The archived composition remains 24 unique courses, 180 EC, 6 advanced courses with valid earlier prerequisites, offered terms and year-one PPD.

The previous comparison assigned general meaning, public life and ordinary belief to interests that concern sacred interpretation, comparative religions and religious experience. The current exception no longer asserts that ownership.
The revised active record includes no UCR alternative, comparison rows or optional-research counterpart. All 26 external components and the corrected interest evidence are retained.
academicJudgment: The substantive concept-to-target relation is not established by the documented assembled curriculum. Coherence as a philosophy/cultural-meaning programme and real bounded religious-cultural contributions do not suffice. This is a reasoned programme-level academic judgment, not a computed matching-row threshold.
strongestCounterargumentConsidered: Broader questions are permitted; several courses substantively engage myth/religion/material culture and complementary methods may be valid without exact VU equivalence. These facts are accepted. They do not establish the missing sustained religious object of inquiry through the whole programme.
originalReasonChallenge: The original main no-match reason already acknowledged concrete related teaching and assessed the assembled programme. Its subsidiary 23-course wording was overstrict and is not restored as a requirement. The reversal overstated that flaw and failed to establish the broader concept’s target validity.
limitedRepairChallenge: Renaming, caveats, looser methods alignment or assuming student-selected religious projects cannot establish absent documented content. Relevant additional catalogue leads were considered without manufacturing a replacement.
uncertainty: An authoritative change in course content or an evidenced programme implementation could warrant reconsideration. No assertion is made about every conceivable future UCR combination. Current evidence supports a completed academic no-match, not an unavailable-evidence blocker.
limitations: Official source hrefs and independently retrieved HTTP200 content were verified; browser rendering of external destination pages is not certified.
No separate human adjudicator participated. This is a source-first challenge and final verification pass by the same AI operator.
